ns2:section.sectionText: This section will have distributed classroom attendance with supplemental instruction. You will receive an email from your instructor with specific attendance directives. Students will learn the fundamentals of ethical theory, corporate social responsibility, case competition formats, presentation skills and case analysis. In addition to weekly class meetings, students are expected to compete in at least one of several external case competitions throughout the semester.
ns2:section.sectionNotes: Restricted to students with Sophomore, Junior, or Senior class standing.
